## Changes

- Fixed compatibility with Fuji on Minecraft 26.2: its direct entity-position reads now observe ECO's shared position state instead of a stale Java field.
- Preserved vanilla section traversal order without sorting native section members during queries, and removed duplicate entity-bounds storage from the native index.
- Avoided allocating empty hard-collision candidate arrays when no hard-collidable entities are present.
- Expanded GameTest coverage for section ordering, shared entity position, and Fuji integration.
